title: Pleasure without present desire
component: When I am with Y / do Y, I often feel something good.
contrast: I do not want to be with Y / do Y now.

title: Desire without positive feeling
component: X wants this / wants to do this.
contrast: X feels nothing good when thinking about it.

title: Possibility in hope
contrast: I know that this cannot happen.

title: Good for another person
component: I want good things to happen to this someone.
contrast: I do not care if bad things happen to this someone.

title: Prior wanting
component: I wanted something like this to happen.
contrast: I had never wanted or thought about this before.

title: Unexpectedness
component: I did not know before that this would happen.
contrast: I had known for a long time that this would happen.

title: Personal beneficiary
contrast: Something good happened only to someone else.

title: Wanting nothing else
component: I do not want anything else now.
contrast: I also want other things now.

title: Duration
component: It has been like this for some time.
contrast: It has been like this for only a few moments.

title: Pleasure in satisfaction
component: X feels something good about this.
contrast: X thinks this is good enough, but feels no good feeling.

title: Prior wish to meet
component: I wanted to see this someone before now.
contrast: I had never thought about seeing this someone.

title: Protection in cherishing
component: I do not want something bad to happen to Y.
contrast: I do not care if something bad happens to Y.

title: Current participation
component: X is doing this now and feels something good.
contrast: X often does this, but now feels bad while doing it.

title: Expressed versus private feeling
contrast: X does nothing that other people can see or hear because of it.

title: Good quality versus attraction
component: I think this is good for doing something.
contrast: I do not want this and feel nothing good towards it.

title: Prior experience
component: When I do this / am with this, I often feel something good.
contrast: I have never done this / been with this before.
